def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    left=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][0]==9]
    right=[r for r in range(h) if g[r][-1]==9]
    seeds=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (6,9)]
    for r,c,v in seeds:
        # Project the lone seed toward the matching boundary and convert it to 4.
        if r in left:
            for x in range(1,c): g[r][x]=v
            g[r][c]=4
        elif r in right:
            for x in range(c+1,w-1): g[r][x]=v
            g[r][c]=4
        else:
            # For a seed in the interior, grow a vertical ray toward the closest
            # edge-band, then continue from there toward the opposite band.
            if r>max(left+right):
                for y in range(max(left+right)+1,r): g[y][c]=v
            elif r<min(left+right):
                for y in range(r+1,min(left+right)): g[y][c]=v
            g[r][c]=4
            # extended line follows the seed's column across all intervening rows
            for y in range(1,h-1):
                if y!=r and g[y][c]==6:g[y][c]=v
    return g
